pu_footer_made_in: Made in Indonesia by Forelsket Gökotta Labs.
pu_footer_faq_a1: Karja helps anyone turn their skills, experience, files, or time into simple products that can be bought through one page and one link.
pu_footer_faq_q2: How much does it cost to start?
pu_footer_faq_a2: Creating and publishing products on Karja is free. A platform fee only applies when a transaction succeeds.
pu_footer_faq_a3: Buyers can pay easily via QRIS and official bank transfer methods.
pu_footer_contact_p1: Karja's official support email will be available here soon.
pu_footer_contact_p2: For now, feel free to try creating your first product page or check the guidance in the FAQ section.
pu_footer_terms_body: Karja provides a simple platform that helps anyone sell digital products, sessions, and services directly to buyers — clearly, safely, and transparently.
pu_footer_privacy_body: Karja keeps user and payment data confidential and never shares personal information with third parties without consent.
pu_store_notfound_desc: This store isn't active yet, or the link you opened is incorrect.
pu_store_empty_desc: No products are showing in this store yet.
